item.title: SIERRA LEVESQUE Unleashes Raw Emotion with New Single ‘Don’t Go’
item.description: Rising rock singer, songwriter, and multi-instrumentalist Sierra Levesque releases her new single “DON’T GO,” available now on all streaming platforms. The track delivers a cinematic rock experience driven by soaring guitars, impassioned vocals, and emotionally charged songwriting that captures the tension between vulnerability and strength. “DON’T GO” was added to the Spotify Editorial Playlist “Rock Now”. Listen here:–https://sierralevesque.hearnow.com/dont-go–https://linktr.ee/sierralevesquem

item.title: Extreme Metal Visionary DANIELE BRUSASCHETTO Unleashes Music Video for ‘Nera’
item.description: Renowned Italian experimental metal visionary Daniele Brusaschetto has officially released the new music video for “Nera,” the latest single from his critically acclaimed album, Dichotomous, out now via Wormholedeath. “Nera” is darkly ironic and unflinching, capturing the tension and decay of a relentless world.
